## Answer  
Marketing expense (account 6100) increased from CAD 8,004 in August to CAD 42,000 in September, a rise of approximately CAD 33,996. This increase fully explains the rise in total operating expenses between August and September 2026.  

## Drivers  
- Marketing expense increase: CAD 33,996 (includes duplicate‑booking overstatement of CAD 12,450 from VEND‑MRP invoice MRP‑88213; genuine higher marketing spend accounts for the remaining CAD 21,546) [E2-5] [E2-1] [Q-gl].
